script_text: Taurus, this week asks you to repair, not control. Early week, the Sun in your Seventh House trines Jupiter in your Third House, while Uranus in your Second House rattles the budget. Monday is best for listening, Tuesday for renegotiating, and Wednesday for choosing peace. Midweek, Venus, your ruling planet, stations direct in Libra, your Sixth House, trine Saturn in Aries, your Twelfth House, turning stalled romance and work alliances toward commitment. By late week, Mercury leaves retrograde in Scorpio, your Seventh House, and Mars in your Second House sextiles Pluto in your Tenth House, helping shared finances and career moves advance. Weekend favors quiet boundaries, not purchases. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Saturn, clarifying love. Monday is your worst day because the Sun squares Pluto, exposing money tension. Ground your Earth element by reviewing contracts before signing. Follow for daily updates.
